name: Camping Moorbad Riedle
beschreibung: The campsite Moorbad Riedle is located in Tirol and stands out for its quiet location in nature. The facility is designed for use by motorhomes and caravans. A special feature is the nearby Moorbad, which is used for therapeutic treatments. The sanitary facilities are designed to be barrier-free. A small lake in the surrounding area invites you to swim. The region is ideal for extended walks and bike tours. In the surrounding area there are several inns serving regional cuisine.
